counterpart_comparisons.claim: V9 proposes a slot-conditioned categorical status/value vector: a picture/paragraph owner activates a latent register stencil, each active slot receives a compact answer packet, and an exact anonymous value/status card carries an attached COMMIT. Repeated exact cards preserve the same anonymous value within that model; the repeated qokeedy in the f82r.27 vector does not independently establish equal dose, treatment, liquid or a ditto sign. The conjecture is broader than binary YES/NO and narrower than assigning every terminal a specific action/result. Operation/result meanings remain a live alternative requiring inherited operands; path/station ownership remains unbound, and the four leading families are absent from the fixed Herbal-B f55v bridge, leaving cross-register material/quality identity unsupported. Local material/quality interpretations and a future collapse to a purely formal closer inventory remain possible. Status, value, slot and commit are analytical classes, every category remains unnamed, and the reported fit ranking is not meaning identification.
